title: HOLD THE DOOR // SHATTERED TEMPORALITY
narrative: Wights claw through the roots into the cavern. Bran's mind stretches across forty years, warging the stableboy Wylis in the Winterfell courtyard while commanding Hodor to hold the heavy subterranean ironwood door. The psychic echo shatters Wylis's mind into a single desperate command: 'Hold the door! Hold the door! Hodor...'

options.text: Make the final stand against the Night King at the Wall.
Discover the ancient secret of the Long Night.
